# mcpdoctor

> Read-only preflight checker for MCP servers and x402 payment endpoints. Open source (MIT), zero dependencies, runs via npx or GitHub Actions. Maintains a public Trust Directory of all 9,991 MCP Registry endpoints with weekly rescans.

Key facts verified by our own scans (October 2026):

- 9,991 MCP Registry endpoints scanned, 4,879 PASS, 43 FAIL, 5,069 no anonymous handshake
- All 213 smithery-registered endpoints failed anonymous handshake (registry hygiene finding)
- Tool: `npx @eidonze/mcpdoctor schema <url>` checks MCP handshake and tool schemas without calling tools
- Tool: `npx @eidonze/mcpdoctor inspect <url>` validates x402 payment challenges without paying

Guides:

- [Test a remote MCP server](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/test-remote-mcp-server.html): check a deployed HTTP endpoint before connecting, CLI with CI exit codes; Inspector vs mcpdoctor comparison
- [MCP schema checker](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/mcp-schema-checker.html): what the schema check validates and how to read results
- [x402 endpoint inspector](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/x402-endpoint-inspector.html): preflight for 402 payment endpoints
- [MCP security CI](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/mcp-security-ci.html): gating MCP servers in CI with GitHub Actions
- [Troubleshooting](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/troubleshooting.html): common MCP handshake and tools/list failures with fixes
- [OAuth diagnostics](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/mcp-oauth-diagnostics.html): auth-gated servers and current limits
- [State of MCP report](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/state-of-mcp-2026-10.html): reliability and schema quality across the registry, with reproducible data
- [Agent Evidence report](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/agent-evidence-sample.html): weekly five-level cross-check of ERC-8004 on-chain agent registrations against their declared MCP endpoints
- [Trust Directory](https://xka0085-byte.github.io/mcp-doctor/trust/): per-server trust reports, badges, and JSON APIs for 9,991 endpoints
